text: 2. Architecture in the grand theaters and stadiums of the Roman Empire featured specialized passage systems designed to allow massive crowds to "spew forth" rapidly onto the streets following a performance. Popular culture, fueled by a misunderstanding of the Latin root vomere, has incorrectly rebranded these architectural exit tunnels as rooms dedicated to the gluttonous purging of multi-course banquets. These structures were about the flow of people, not the reversal of digestion. What is the singular term for such a passageway?
